name: Parrot OS 7 Security Web Terminal (Browser Shell)
description: Parrot OS security shell in a browser tab: nmap, sqlmap, ffuf, hydra.

PASSWORD.description: Browser login password, generated at deploy (copy it from this variable). 12-256 chars; a shorter or empty one locks the login.

USERNAME.description: Browser login name (letters, digits, . _ -). The Linux account is always 'parrot', with sudo.

PORT.description: Port of the auth proxy (nginx). The public domain and healthcheck use it. ttyd stays on 127.0.0.1:7681.

TERMINAL_TMUX.description: true: each tab attaches to a tmux session that survives closed tabs and reconnects. false: a new bash per tab.

TERMINAL_FONT_SIZE.description: Font size of the browser terminal (8-40).

PARROT_EXTRA_PACKAGES.description: Optional. Extra Parrot packages baked into the image at build, e.g. metasploit-framework or parrot-tools-web. Changing it rebuilds.

TZ.description: Time zone of the shell, e.g. Europe/Istanbul.

RAILWAY_DEPLOYMENT_DRAINING_SECONDS.description: Seconds between stop signal and kill on redeploy, so tmux shells exit cleanly and save history.
